headlines.title: Google stock's historically bad day raises fears of AI bubble popping
headlines.description: Google's parent company Alphabet lost over $500 billion in market value today. So is the AI bubble about to pop? NBC News' Allie Canal reports on big tech's spending and how AI is impacting the job market.

headlines.title: Stock market reacts amid concerns about artificial intelligence spending
headlines.description: Watch a live look at the New York Stock Exchange big board as the market reacts to concerns about the current artificial intelligence boom.

headlines.title: Binance says user funds are safe after thieves make off with billions in largest-ever crypto hack
headlines.description: A record-setting cyberattack targeting the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange has rocked the digital assets industry.

headlines.title: Trump uncancels weekend rallies in Iowa and Kansas with Senate control at stake
headlines.description: Senate races in both states are considered toss-ups and could be key in either party’s path to control of Congress.

headlines.title: Alaska Governor Announces Criminal Investigation of Senate Race
headlines.description: Alaska’s Republican Gov. Mike Dunleavy is ordering a criminal investigation into the state’s closely watched Senate race. It comes as the Department of Justice has issued as many as three dozen subpoenas as part of a separate federal investigation on an alleged plot to sabotage the campaign of Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan by Democrat Mary Peltola’s campaign. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Go Behind the Scenes of NBC News’ Decision Desk
headlines.description: TODAY’s Savannah Guthrie goes behind-the-scenes with the NBC News team tasked with calling election night’s pivotal races from coast-to-coast.

headlines.title: 'There is pain in my mind and in my soul': Christa Pike speaks out after failed execution
headlines.description: Christa Pike, the woman who survived two lethal injection attempts last month, is speaking publicly for the first time since her failed execution. NBC News’ Jesse Kirsch breaks down a new statement released by Pike’s team and the legal questions surrounding what comes next.

headlines.title: Patrick Stewart, Known for 'Star Trek' and 'X-Men' Roles, Dies at 86
headlines.description: Actor Patrick Stewart, known for his roles in "Star Trek" and "X-Men" has died after a brief battle with Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy body dementia, according to a statement. Now, tributes are pouring in for the legendary actor whose career spanned more than six decades from the Shakespearean stage to the big and small screen. Stewart was 86. NBC’s Liz Kreutz reports for TODAY on his remarkable career.

headlines.title: Daylight Saving Time for 2026 Ends on Halloween Weekend
headlines.description: On Sunday morning, most Americans will “fall back” and switch their clocks back an hour to Standard time — and this year, the change is happening on Halloween weekend! NBC’s Joe Fryer reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: ICE officer is indicted after striking, injuring immigrant with his vehicle in Houston
headlines.description: A Texas grand jury indicted ICE agent Mario Alberto Morales on a charge of aggravated assault with a deadly weapon.

headlines.title: Final election results show neither Netanyahu nor rival can immediately form government
headlines.description: Parties led by Israel’s Arab minority made historic gains, winning a combined 19 seats in a race in which Palestinians with Israeli citizenship headed to the polls in record numbers.

headlines.title: Many on ACA plans face a new crisis in 2027: Insurers fleeing the market
headlines.description: Eleven insurers have announced plans to leave some state ACA marketplaces in 2027.
